svg.text: Finite-window physical slow-set risk: all answers
Truth: same-window physical top-2; predicted scores / independent REF variance (ddof=0); lag = {4,16,32}.
Observed error rate (log1p color scale; saturated at 50%)
CAL=2048 independent windows; TEST=4096; REF=32768 states. Dots are point estimates, not simultaneous risk certificates.
Nested T prefixes and shared innovations across alpha/R2; cells are paired. own-CAL coverage is approximately 50%, not fixed at exactly 50%.
